title: Caida Libre
description: Martin Madrazo hires Michael to silence his cousin Javier, who plans to testify against him and is flying to Liberty City with a briefcase of incriminating files. Using a high-caliber computer-guided sniper rifle mounted inside a van at the Galileo Observatory, Michael must cripple the aircraft mid-flight while Trevor chases the burning fuselage across Blaine County.
goldRequirements: Floor It — Reach top speed on the Sanchez
Glued to the Seat — Don't fall off the Sanchez
One Two Three — Shoot down the plane with 3 shots
Time — Complete within 09:45
reward: Michael and Trevor are exiled from Los Santos. Unlocks the Sandy Shores safehouse for both.

title: Deep Inside
description: Devin Weston demands another legendary vehicle for his collection: the vintage Dewbauchee JB 700 currently being used on a spy film shoot at Richards Majestic Studios. Franklin sneaks onto the backlot, knocks out the lead actor and steals the prop car, discovering its ejector seat and road spikes are fully functional.
goldRequirements: Not a Scratch — Deliver the JB 700 with minimal damage
Fastest Speed — Reach top speed in the JB 700
Stealthy Recasting — Knock out the actor using a stealth attack
Premature Ejector — Hit the ejector seat within 10 seconds
Second Strike — Run over the actor as you escape in the JB 700
reward: Another classic car delivered to Devin Weston's garage.

title: Minor Turbulence
description: Tired of working for free for federal agents and eager to expand Trevor Philips Industries, Trevor takes off in a rickety crop duster to board a massive Merryweather military cargo plane mid-flight over Blaine County and seize its heavy weaponry.
goldRequirements: Accuracy — Finish with a shooting accuracy of at least 80%
Four Wheel Flier — Exit the cargo plane in the Mesa
reward: None. The entire cargo sinks to the bottom of the Alamo Sea.

title: Paleto Score Setup
description: Forced to fund a black-ops raid for the FIB while exiled in Blaine County, Michael and Trevor meet Lester in Sandy Shores. Together they scope out the Blaine County Savings Bank in Paleto Bay, a quiet rural branch holding millions in dirty cartel and corrupt sheriff kickbacks.
goldRequirements: Leisurely Drive — Drive to the bank within 03:30
Winner — Win the race back to the meth lab
reward: Unlocks setup preparations for the Paleto Score.

title: Military Hardware
description: Out for blood after the destruction of their meth farm, the surviving O'Neil brothers head out to ambush Trevor. After crashing their SUV deep into Raton Canyon, they scatter into the dense forest at dusk, prompting Michael, Trevor, Franklin and Chop to coordinate a combined air-and-ground manhunt.
goldRequirements: Accuracy — Finish with a shooting accuracy of at least 70%
Time — Complete within 09:00
Headshots — Kill 3 enemies with headshots
Thin the Herd — Do not kill any animals
reward: None. Vengeance and elimination of the remaining O'Neil brothers.

title: Predator
description: Knowing that Paleto Bay law enforcement boasts heavy armor and militarized response teams, Lester devises an overwhelming brute-force plan: outfitting the crew in heavy ballistic Juggernaut armor and rotary miniguns. To acquire the gear, the gang intercepts an Army supply convoy rolling down the Great Ocean Highway.
goldRequirements: Head Hunter — Kill 5 enemies with headshots
Sticky Strategist — Stop the convoy using a Sticky Bomb trap
reward: Heavy ballistic armor and firepower secured for the Paleto Score.

title: The Paleto Score
description: An all-out armed assault on the Blaine County Savings Bank in Paleto Bay using heavy rotary miniguns and full-body ballistic armor. The crew withstands a combined siege by SWAT and the U.S. Army until Franklin smashes through the blockade in a heavy bulldozer to clear a path to the train tracks.
goldRequirements: Let It Rain — Fire over 4,000 rounds of ammo
Accuracy — Finish with a shooting accuracy of at least 50%
Collateral Damage — Cause $1,000,000 of damage in Paleto Bay
Time — Complete within 16:00
reward: Approx. $450,000 net payout per character

title: Derailed
description: A daring motorcycle jump onto a speeding freight train to force a head-on collision over the Zancudo River bridge. With the cargo cars plunged into the rapids below, Michael pulls up in a Dinghy to blow open the sunken container while fending off Merryweather tactical squads.
goldRequirements: Time — Complete within 11:30
Fastest Speed — Reach top speed on the Sanchez
Better Than CJ — Land on the train using the first jump
Separation — Complete the mission without detaching
High Velocity — Reach top speed in the Dinghy
reward: High-value historical artifact for Martin Madrazo

title: Monkey Business
description: Under orders from Steve Haines and Dave Norton to stop an IAA chemical weapons program, the trio infiltrates the heavily guarded Humane Labs facility. Michael dives through underwater intake pipes to steal an experimental neurotoxin before Trevor extracts the cargo by air in a Cargobob.
goldRequirements: Stunner — Stun 8 enemies with the Stun Gun
Headshots — Kill 15 enemies with headshots
Accuracy — Finish with a shooting accuracy of at least 70%
Time — Complete within 13:30
reward: Settles the FIB black-ops demand. Trevor reconciles the dispute with Martin Madrazo.

title: Hang Ten
description: Debra's return to her Vespucci Beach condo sparks a violent confrontation with Floyd and Trevor that ends in an off-screen bloodbath. Covered in blood, Trevor steers an oblivious Wade away from the crime scene and relocates to the Vanilla Unicorn strip club, which he has forcefully taken over as his new Los Santos headquarters.
goldRequirements: Time — Complete within 04:00
reward: Trevor takes over the Vanilla Unicorn strip club, which becomes his Los Santos safehouse.

title: Surveying the Score
description: Gathered in the back office of the Vanilla Unicorn with Lester, the trio sets their sights on the ultimate criminal prize: robbing the Union Depository of over two hundred million dollars in gold bullion. To plan the score of the century, the crew conducts coordinated ground and aerial reconnaissance across Downtown Los Santos.
goldRequirements: Perfect Distance — Follow the vans without being warned about distance
Cavity Search — Find the construction hole within 20 seconds
Under the Bridge / Tunnel Flight — Fly under the bridge while following the vans and fly through a tunnel
reward: Unlocks the official Big Score planning board (Subtle or Obvious).

title: Bury the Hatchet
description: Consumed by suspicion, Trevor flies to the frozen town of Ludendorff to dig up the grave bearing Michael Townley's name. Discovering the decomposing body of Brad Snider inside the coffin, the bitter standoff between the former partners is cut short by an ambush from Wei Cheng's Triads, leaving Michael stranded and captured in the snow.
goldRequirements: Time — Complete within 11:00
Headshots — Kill 20 enemies with headshots
Accuracy — Finish with a shooting accuracy of at least 80%
reward: Temporary fracture of the crew; Trevor learns the truth about Brad.

title: Pack Man
description: Having collected every exotic car on Devin Weston's list, Franklin, Lamar and Trevor load the five supercars onto a Packer car carrier bound for Paleto Bay. When highway patrol cruisers spot the stolen shipment and launch a high-speed pursuit, Franklin climbs into the weaponized JB 700 on the upper deck to fight off the police.
goldRequirements: Mission Time — Complete within 12:00
Not a Scratch — Deliver the JB 700 with minimal damage
Shredder — Disable 3 police cars using the spike strips
reward: None. Weston refuses to pay the crew.

title: Fresh Meat
description: Kidnapped in North Yankton by Wei Cheng's Triads after being mistaken for Trevor's lover, Michael is held captive inside the Raven Slaughterhouse in Cypress Flats. Tipped off by Lester, Franklin races against the clock using a phone tracking app to locate the meatpacking plant and save Michael from the industrial meat grinder.
goldRequirements: Switch Limiter — Don't switch characters more than 3 times
Accuracy — Finish with a shooting accuracy of at least 70%
Headshots — Kill 10 enemies with headshots
Swift Rescue — Rescue Michael within 03:30
Sense of Direction — Don't use any map waypoints
reward: Michael is rescued and rejoins the heist crew.

title: Cleaning out the Bureau
description: Arriving at Richards Majestic Studios after a frantic call from Solomon Richards, Michael catches mobster Rocco Pelosi and his associate Gianni roughing up the elderly producer. Outraged by the attack on his mentor, Michael launches into a high-speed pursuit through Vinewood to permanently eliminate the Liberty City extortionist.
goldRequirements: Time — Complete within 03:00
reward: Michael is officially credited as Associate Producer on Solomon's film.

title: Architect's Plans
description: To prepare for the raid on FIB headquarters and wipe the files incriminating Steve Haines and Michael, the crew needs inside access. Michael stakes out the federal building to tail janitor Harvey Molina home and intimidate him into handing over his work overalls and security pass.
goldRequirements: Eagle Eye — Check all the license plates
He Missed a Spot — Follow the janitor without being spotted
Time — Complete within 09:00
reward: Unlocks the official FIB Raid planning board.

title: Fire Truck
description: After months of estrangement in an empty mansion, Jimmy reaches out to Michael to help bring the family back together. Together they drive across Los Santos to rescue Amanda from Fabien's pretentiousness and Tracey from Lazlow's sleazy advances, culminating in a chaotic group therapy session with Dr. Friedlander.
goldRequirements: Time — Complete within 10:30
reward: The De Santa family moves back into the mansion. Family vehicles become available again.

title: Getaway Vehicle
description: To plan the raid on the FIB tower, Lester needs the exact structural blueprints of the federal building. Franklin heads to the Mile High Club construction site in Pillbox Hill to track down the project architect, seize his briefcase containing the floor plans, and make a fast getaway.
goldRequirements: Quick Getaway — Leave the construction site within 45 seconds
reward: Building blueprints secured for the Bureau Raid.

title: The Bureau Raid
description: Devin Weston schemes to shut down production of 'Meltdown' and destroy the only master copy of the film to collect a massive insurance payout. Refusing to let his cinematic debut be ruined, Michael pursues Weston's panicked lawyer Molly Schultz onto the active runways of Los Santos International Airport.
goldRequirements: Time — Complete within 05:30
Floor It — Reach top speed in any car
Clean Escape — Lose the wanted level within 02:00
News Hound — View the Weazel News camera for 15 seconds
reward: Saves the release of 'Meltdown'.

title: The Ballad of Rocco
description: A bold raid on FIB Headquarters in Downtown Los Santos to steal classified server drives. Depending on the selected approach, the crew either plants incendiary bombs as a janitor and enters disguised as firefighters, or executes a night HALO parachute drop directly onto the skyscraper roof.
goldRequirements: Time — Complete within 18:00
Accuracy — Finish with a shooting accuracy of at least 70%
Headshots — Kill 20 enemies with headshots
Out of Breath — Escape with at least 40% oxygen remaining (Fire Crew) / Hacker — Hack the system within 45 seconds (Roof Entry)
reward: Erases the incriminating FIB files on Michael and Steve Haines

title: Lamar Down
description: Michael meets Dave Norton and Steve Haines at the Kortz Center cultural complex, where tensions erupt into a chaotic three-way firefight between FIB tactical teams, IAA agents, and Merryweather contractors. Pinned down on the museum terraces, Michael only makes it out alive thanks to Trevor's unexpected sniper cover from the rooftops.
goldRequirements: Time — Complete within 07:00
Headshots — Kill 18 enemies with headshots
Whirly Bird — Shoot down the pursuing chopper
reward: Dave Norton and Michael's survival

title: Meltdown
description: A three-man rescue operation at the Paleto Forest sawmill to save Lamar from a Ballas ambush. Franklin recruits Michael and Trevor to coordinate a multi-angle assault on the lumber mill and extract Lamar safely.
goldRequirements: Headshots — Kill 18 enemies with headshots
Accuracy — Finish with a shooting accuracy of at least 70%
Three Way — Kill an enemy with all 3 characters
Time — Complete within 13:30
reward: Lamar's bond and survival

title: Parenting 101
description: Michael's big Vinewood movie premiere is cut short by a veiled threat from Devin Weston against the De Santa family. Michael races back to his Rockford Hills residence to repel a Merryweather hit squad and rescue Amanda and Tracey inside the mansion.
goldRequirements: Time — Complete within 06:30
Pedal to the Metal — Reach top speed in any vehicle
Tier One — Kill 12 enemies with headshots
Saving Face — Kill the mercenaries attacking Amanda and Tracey with headshots
reward: Full reunion of the De Santa family

title: Drilling the Hole
description: To execute the Obvious Approach for the Union Depository heist, the crew needs heavy industrial equipment capable of boring straight through the reinforced underground vault walls. The team locates a massive HVY Cutter loaded onto a flatbed trailer in La Mesa and mounts a covert operation to steal it.
goldRequirements: Sneak Thief — Steal the cutter without being detected
Time — Complete within 05:00
reward: HVY Cutter tunnel boring machine secured for The Big Score (Obvious Approach).

title: Sidewrecked
description: As part of the Obvious Approach for the Union Depository heist, the crew needs a freight train to haul the stolen gold out of the city. Michael and Trevor infiltrate the power station rail switch, divert an incoming freight train, and use a heavy-lift Skylift helicopter to airlift both the locomotive and a flatbed car to Sandy Shores.
goldRequirements: Time — Complete within 04:30
Undetected — Steal the train without being spotted
reward: Freight locomotive and flatbed car stolen to haul the gold in the Obvious Approach.

title: Getaway Vehicle
description: The ultimate heist on the Union Depository in Pillbox Hill to steal two hundred million dollars in gold bullion. Depending on the selected plan, the crew either infiltrates the vault in stolen armored vans and escapes in heavily modified muscle cars, or drills straight through the subterranean vault wall and airlifts the gold out by helicopter.
goldRequirements: Headshots — Kill 20 enemies with headshots
Time — Complete within 16:00
Cha-Ching — Drop the gold onto the train within 30 seconds (Obvious) / Signal Man — Perform fewer than 10 traffic light changes (Subtle)
Accuracy — Finish with a shooting accuracy of at least 60%
reward: Approx. $20,000,000 – $41,000,000 for each of the three protagonists

title: The Big Score (Subtle)
description: A targeted corporate hit commissioned by Lester Crest to manipulate pharmaceutical stock prices. Franklin stakes out the Von Crastenburg Hotel in Richman and eliminates Bilkinton Research CEO Brett Lowrey before his motorcade departs.
goldRequirements: Time — Complete within 05:00
Sniper Boy — Kill the target using a sniper rifle
Money Earned — $9,000
reward: $9,000 + massive stock market returns

title: The Big Score (Obvious)
description: To prevent Redwood Cigarettes from rigging a class-action lawsuit and send rival Debonaire's stock soaring on the LCN, Lester tasks Franklin with eliminating four bribed jurors across Los Santos within a strict nine-minute window.
goldRequirements: Speedy Killer — Kill all targets as quickly as possible
Money Earned — $7,000
reward: Massive stock surge for Debonaire (DEB) on the LCN.

title: Something Sensible (Option A)
description: To boost Fruit Computers against rival tech giant Facade on the BAWSAQ exchange, Lester orders the elimination of Facade's head of product development, Jackson Skinner, who has been selling user data. Franklin stakes out La Puerta and takes Skinner out during his nightly rendezvous with a streetwalker.
goldRequirements: Clean Escape — Lose the cops without alerting them
Money Earned — $5,000
reward: Fruit Computers (FRT) stock rises ~50% on BAWSAQ.

title: The Time's Come (Option B)
description: Lester orchestrates a stock market crash for Vapid Motor Company by targeting prospective buyer Isaac Penny—a billionaire Venture capitalist so notoriously frugal that he refuses to own a car and commutes exclusively by city bus. Franklin poses as a transit bus driver along Penny's daily route to intercept and eliminate him.
goldRequirements: Hit and Run — Kill the target using the bus
Money Earned — $7,000
reward: Vapid (VAP) stock market manipulation.

title: The Third Way (Option C)
description: To rescue GoldCoast Development on the LCN stock exchange, Lester orders the elimination of Enzo Bonelli—a mobbed-up real estate developer who uses union extortion and violence to monopolize city construction contracts. Franklin infiltrates the Mile High Club skyscraper under construction, fights his way up through private security, and takes down Bonelli before his helicopter can escape the roof.
goldRequirements: No Fly Zone — Shoot down the target's helicopter
Money Earned — $10,000
reward: GoldCoast Development (GCD) stock manipulation on the LCN.

title: The Third Way - Finale
description: Pressured by Steve Haines and Dave Norton to eliminate Trevor as an unpredictable liability to the FIB, Franklin arranges a meeting in El Burro Heights under false pretenses. Realizing the ambush, Trevor flees in his pickup truck until Michael rams him into a fuel tanker at the Murrieta Oil Field, sealing his grim fate.
goldRequirements: Judas! — Kill Trevor
Time — Complete within 06:00
reward: Union Depository heist cut split between Franklin and Michael (Trevor dies permanently)

title: The Last One
description: Caving to pressure from billionaire Devin Weston, Franklin turns on his mentor, Michael De Santa. A high-speed pursuit leads to the Palmer-Taylor Power Station, where a tense foot chase up the industrial catwalks culminates with Michael dangling over the edge of a towering smokestack.
goldRequirements: Surpassed the Mentor — Kill Michael
Time — Complete within 07:00
reward: Union Depository heist cut split between Franklin and Trevor (Michael dies permanently)

title: Prologue Redux
description: Refusing to betray either of his partners to the FIB or Devin Weston, Franklin chooses 'Deathwish'—The Third Way. The trio lures FIB tactical squads and Merryweather mercenaries into an all-out firefight at an industrial foundry, splits up to eliminate Wei Cheng, Stretch, and Steve Haines across Los Santos, and abducts Devin Weston to settle accounts once and for all.
goldRequirements: Time — Complete within 21:30
Headshots — Kill 20 enemies with headshots
Accuracy — Finish with a shooting accuracy of at least 70%
Cheng Reaction — Kill Wei Cheng with a Sticky Bomb
Lead Lobotomy — Kill Steve Haines with a headshot
Stretched Out — Kill Stretch with a melee attack
reward: Union Depository heist payout (~$20M–$41M each) and all three protagonists alive and playable
